issue: App crashes after login when SSO is enabled.
resolution: Disabled 'legacy SSO mode' and cleared cached tokens. Crash stopped.

issue: Export to CSV produces empty file for large reports.
resolution: Increased export timeout to 120s and switched export mode to 'streaming'.

issue: Users intermittently get 'Session expired' every ~10 minutes.
resolution: Fixed clock skew by enforcing NTP sync and rotating session keys.

issue: Audit log missing entries for bulk updates.
resolution: Enabled async audit worker and increased queue retention to 48 hours.
